name: reverse-grip-incline-push-up
instructions:
1. Assume a tall kneeling position with your hands on a bench, toes tucked, and knees under hips.
2. Extend one leg at a time and assume a pushup position with the legs straight, elbows extended, and head in a neutral position looking at the floor.
3. Rotate the hands to a reverse grip so the fingers are pointing downward.
4. Slowly descend to the floor by retracting the shoulder blades and unlocking the elbows.
5. Descend until your chest touches the bench.
6. Push back to the starting point by extending the elbows and driving your palms into the bench.
7. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
